design.scope: Gaussian window-size sensitivity only; no Huber, theta model, or hypothesis test
design.coarse_selection: Original per-column positive Sobel maximum, calculated once and frozen
design.coarse_gate: Original min_peak=8; reject peak at search-band endpoints
design.initial_simplex_sigma_step: 0.5 * initial_sigma, constant across windows in each start series
design.solver: Original C++ Nelder-Mead verbatim; max_iter=800, relative objective spread tol=1e-10
design.raw_results: All attempted fits retained; no Huber trimming or newly invented quality cutoff
design.primary_comparison_cohort: Same columns accepted by legacy gate in ALL main windows, fixed initial sigma=11
design.initialization_audit: Compare fixed starts 5,11,21 at same window; never select best start to mask sensitivity
design.reason: No approved px tolerance for window-induced mu change. Descriptive sensitivity, not pass/fail accuracy.
